title: Read A Member's Savings Balance On The Teller Terminal
description: On the green screen teller terminal, takes member inquiry from the main menu, looks a member up by number and reports their name, membership status and savings balance.
goal: From the main menu, choose member inquiry, look up the member whose number is {member_number}, and report their name, their membership status and the balance of their savings account.

outputs.name: member_name
outputs.description: Full name as held on file.

outputs.name: savings_balance
outputs.description: Balance on the member's savings account.

outcomes.description: No member exists with that number.
The member exists but holds no savings account, so there is no savings balance to report.
outcomes.signal_text: The member holds no savings account
